title: Chalet Mer | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Lovely home:* Upgraded - AND views of the pool from your window!* 4 Bikes Included!* Blue Mountain Beach Access - (parking, restrooms and seasonal lifeguards)* Pool w/Waterfall (Seasonally heated starting in March), Hot Tub, Gazebo, Community
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Lovely home:* Upgraded - AND views of the pool from your window!* 4 Bikes Included!* Blue Mountain Beach Access - (parking, restrooms and seasonal lifeguards)* Pool w/Waterfall (Seasonally heated starting in March), Hot Tub, Gazebo, Community Grilling Area, 360-Observation Tower* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Near Redfish Village at Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, and Gulf Place. * Under 1 mile to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service**This property is not available to adults Under the age of 25. No Exceptions.*Chalet Mer is a gorgeous home in Highland Parks, adjacent to the best pool of 30A, Highland Parks Pool! This home includes amazing neighborhood amenities such as a free form tropically landscaped lagoon pool with whirlpool, community grilling area, and fire-pit with comfy chairs and couches - sit, chat and enjoy your favorite drink with your family and friends! A 360-observation tower allows you to see the gulf, the bay, and miles along the coast to Seaside and Sandestin in either direction. This beautiful 3 bed, 3 bath home features a gourmet kitchen with stainless steel appliances and granite countertops, washer/dryer, hardwood floors in main area, carpeted bedrooms, a flat screen TV, and an open floor plan perfect for entertaining. This home sleeps 6 guests. On the main floor, there is a king bed in the master with a full bath, as well as a half guest bath; and on the second floor you will find 2 guest rooms with queen beds, a full bath, and another half bath. Relax on the new outdoor furniture on the front and back porches! Get the full 30A experience by staying at Chalet Mer, only a short drive away to Redfish Village where you will find an array of options of food and fun! Bed Setup:First Floor:Master Bedroom: King Bed with full, private bathroomHalf Guest BathSecond Floor:Guest Room 1: Queen Bed Guest Room 2: Queen Bed Full Guest BathHalf Guest Bath*Parking only available for 2 vehicles in the home's designated paved driveway. Street parking is not allowed. Violations are strictly enforced by the HOA.*AREA ATTRACTIONS: Highland Parks is the newest neighborhood in Blue Mountain Beach featuring a fantastic neighborhood pool with a waterfall, hot tub, gazebo, fire pit, snack bar, and observation tower. The area is the highest point in South Walton County and surrounded by great eateries and local eclectic shops. Highland Parks is perfectly situated between Redfish Village and Gulf Place Town Center on Hwy 30A! Enjoy dining at local favorites The Perfect Pig, Red Door, Local Catch, or Basmati's. Check out the local art scene at Justin Gaffery’s art gallery.Seaside is a fantastic destination, most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. Its incredible architecture has helped to make it famous but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous, There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here.Bike over to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for some homemade scoops that will have your taste buds coming back! You'll have an array of dining options to choose from!The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
